set -euo pipefail
python3 - <<'PY'
import importlib.util, json
mods={}
for name in ['torch','pocket_tts','scipy','numpy','huggingface_hub']:
    s=importlib.util.find_spec(name); mods[name]=None if s is None else s.origin
print(json.dumps(mods,sort_keys=True))
if mods['torch']:
 import torch; print('torch_version='+str(torch.__version__)); print('torch_cuda='+str(torch.version.cuda)); print('torch_threads='+str(torch.get_num_threads()))
PY
printf '%s\n' '--- hf pocket cache ---'
find "$HOME/.cache/huggingface/hub" -maxdepth 2 -type d \( -iname '*pocket*tts*' -o -iname '*tts*voices*' \) -printf '%p\n' 2>/dev/null | head -80 || true
printf '%s\n' '--- likely pocket envs/binaries ---'
find "$HOME" -maxdepth 4 \( -type f -o -type l \) \( -name 'pocket-tts' -o -name 'activate' \) -print 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'pocket|tts' | head -80 || true
